text: A "fully booked" calendar is often celebrated as a sign of high productivity, but a 100% utilization rate is usually just a metric of poor planning. If your day is back-to-back meetings from nine to five, when do you actually execute the strategy you just discussed? I’ve seen leaders brag about being busy while failing to move the needle on core projects. We must stop measuring success by sheer activity and start measuring it by actual output. Busy is not a business strategy.
